subject: ClearView: BYOK / retention / audit-log granularity follow-up
messages:
From: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@clearviewhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@clearviewhealth.com
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial questionnaire: retention, BYOK, audit log granularity

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement needs a short checklist from us to keep the contract on track. Can you confirm the following for ClearView:

- Can audit logs be exported per-tenant with object-level events (e.g., prompt IDs, model version, requester IP, policy decision)?
- What are the default data retention windows for chat transcripts and inference logs? Is a short 90-day window available, and can we request a 1-year escrow?
- BYOK/KMS: can keys be customer-managed in hosted mode or only for Dedicated/Private? How does key rotation affect existing encrypted artifacts (kv cache, saved sessions)?
- SSO & session logs: can we get session start/end, SAML assertion IDs, and user-impersonation events for audit?

We need answers by March 10 to keep the procurement timeline. I attached our questionnaire. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

—Asha
Asha Reddy
Sr. InfoSec Manager | ClearView Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: ClearView questionnaire — triage and answers needed

Marissa / Karthik / Marcus —

Forwarding ClearView's list. Procurement is on a tight timeline (answers by 3/10). High level ask: are there immediate blockers for providing their desired evidence and configuration options from hosted?

My read:
- Audit log export per-tenant + object-level events — product work but plausible as an export feature; will need retention policy flags.
- Retention windows — we have default token-level retention but not a tenant-facing retention SLA; need clarity on short-window offering and escrow for 1 year.
- BYOK in hosted — currently we only support customer-managed keys for Dedicated/Private; hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS with limited rotation guarantees.
- SSO/session logs — we capture session events but don’t surface all SAML assertion ids in the standard export.

Can each of you reply with: 1) what we can commit to for ClearView within hosted today, 2) recommended minimal workaround (timeline & owner), and 3) any blockers that require Dedicated/Private?

I added the questionnaire and a rough diagram of what I think ClearView expects (attached). I can join any vendor call.

Thanks —Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 12:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: ClearView questionnaire — triage and answers needed

Jordan — quick compliance take while we triage technically:

- Audit logs: For SOC2 evidence we need immutable, time-ordered logs per tenant. Object-level events are preferred but we can accept a mapped event export as long as the mapping is documented and stable. ClearView will want assurance that exported logs include tamper-evidence (checksums) and user identifiers.
- Retention: 90-day default is acceptable for most customers; ClearView's request for a 1-year escrow is reasonable as an exception. We should propose: default hosted retention = 90 days; optional 365-day escrow as a paid add-on (export + storage + HSM-backed signature). Need legal to sign off on escrow SLA.
- BYOK: If they require customer-managed KMS for key custody, that is a Dedicated/Private-only capability. For hosted, propose an escrow/segregation pattern (encrypted export delivered to customer KMS) as an interim control.
- SSO/session logs: Provide session start/end and basic SAML metadata today. If they require assertion IDs and step-level impersonation tracking, that’s product work but we can support via a structured log export within 3 sprints (depending on bandwidth).

Action items for us: 1) produce a one-page "ClearView compliance response" listing what we can provide now vs roadmap, 2) scope the escrow offering with Legal & Billing, 3) confirm whether we can add assertion IDs to export schema (Karthik to estimate).

Marissa
Director, Compliance & Trust

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: ClearView questionnaire — triage and answers needed

Technical summary and options (short):

What we can do today (hosted):
- Provide a structured audit export (JSON lines) containing request_id, timestamp, model_id, truncated_prompt_hash, response_token_count, requester_ip, user_id, and policy_verdict. We do not currently export SAML assertion IDs or the raw prompt text by default (PII concerns).
- Retention: configurable at the org level in our admin console but not yet a UI-exposed per-tenant SLA; backend supports retention flags (90/180/365) but 365 requires storage escrow and signed manifests.

Recommended workarounds for ClearView (short-term):
1) Escrow export: run daily encrypted export (TLS + customer public key) to a preconfigured S3 bucket. We can sign manifests with Redwood HSM for tamper evidence. Delivery: 2 weeks to operationalize once legal & billing OK.
2) Assertion IDs & session detail: store these in the session event stream (already captured); add to the export schema is ~2 sprint effort (prod + infra + QA).
3) BYOK: hosted cannot mount customer KMS keys for live encryption in the current multi-tenant runtime; options:
   - Move ClearView to Dedicated (customer-managed KMS): full support, timeline depends on onboarding capacity (4-6 weeks).
   - Offer encrypted daily export to their KMS + short-term key escrow for saved artifacts: ~3 weeks to implement operationally.

Blockers: legal sign-off for escrow SLA, infra runbook for daily export, and a small product ticket to add assertion ID to export schema. I'll open infra + prod tickets and CC owners.

Karthik
Sr. Engineering Manager, Platform

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@clearviewhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 15:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ClearView: BYOK / retention / audit log granularity follow-up

Asha — thanks for the questionnaire and patience. Quick update and proposed next steps: 

1) Immediate (hosted) commitments we can make today:
   - Structured audit export (JSONL) with request_id, timestamp, model_id, requester_ip, user_id, policy_verdict.
   - Org-level retention config: default 90 days; we can enable a 365-day escrow export as an add-on (export + signed manifests).
   - SSO/session logs: we can surface session start/end and basic SAML metadata now. Assertion IDs can be added to the export schema — engineering estimate 2 sprints.

2) BYOK / KMS:
   - Hosted does NOT support customer-managed keys for live encryption. If ClearView requires live KMS isolation, they need Dedicated/Private.
   - Interim: we will provide a daily encrypted export to your KMS (or an S3 bucket you control) and sign the manifests with our HSM. Operationalization estimate: ~2–3 weeks after legal & billing approval.

3) Timeline & owners:
   - Marissa: produce the one-page compliance response (ETA 3/5).
   - Karthik: open infra & product tickets for daily export and assertion-ID export; estimate to infra ticket in 48 hours and deliver a timeline.
   - Marcus: please advise on pricing / escrow add-on phrasing so I can share with ClearView procurement.

Next step: Jordan + Marissa + Karthik propose a 30-min call with Asha next Wednesday (3/10) to walk through the plan and confirm procurement milestones. Asha — would 10am PT work?

Attachments: ClearView_Security_Questions_2026.pdf, proposed-map-byok-diff.png

—Jordan
Director, Solutions
